TRANSCATHETER AORTIC VALVE REPLACEMENT PROCEDURE NOTE

Given the patient's larger native annulus, the heart team selected the balloon-expandable
Sapien platform, Ultra generation, for this transfemoral transcatheter aortic valve
replacement.

Implant Size: 29

The valve was deployed under rapid pacing in excellent position with no paravalvular leak
on final aortography. Post-deployment echocardiography showed the mean gradient is 6 mmHg
with an effective orifice area of 2.1 cm2.
